theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Trump Teleprompter Pays $170,000 to End Insider Trading Probe
top_news.summary: A White House teleprompter operator will pay more than $172,000 to end a federal regulator’s probe into alleged well-timed prediction market bets about President Donald Trump’s speeches.

top_news.title: Panama Canal Congestion Drives Gas Tankers to Unusual Routes
top_news.summary: Growing congestion at the Panama Canal is forcing some gas tankers into unusual journeys, from a rare detour around South America to the possible emergence of shuttling through the waterway.

top_news.title: Indian Bank Stocks Show Widest Exchange Price Gap in Decades
top_news.summary: Shares of some Indian banks closed at sharply different prices on the country’s two largest exchanges on Thursday, the latest sign of dislocation under the new closing auction system.

top_news.title: Two-Year Yield Jumps on Warsh’s Inflation Pledge: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street traders sent short-term yields sharply higher as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh vowed to bring inflation to the target, boosting bets on a rate hike and stabilizing longer-dated bonds.

top_news.title: IMF's Georgieva on Warsh's Speech, 'Stubborn' Inflation
top_news.summary: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva says Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh "did a great job" in his Jackson Hole speech. Speaking with Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz on "Bloomberg The Close." Georgieva also discusses recent inflation pressures and whether they reflect central bank failure or other forces. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Billionaire Gilinski, GeoPark Said to Be Near Venezuela Oil Deal
top_news.summary: Colombia’s richest family is nearing a Venezuela oil deal in conjunction with GeoPark Ltd, a Bogota-based oil company in which it is the largest shareholder with a 28% stake, according to people familiar with the matter who asked for anonymity discussing confidential plans.

top_news.title: Threat of a Fed Rate Hike Is Changing the Leadership in Markets, Slimmon Says
top_news.summary: Andrew Slimmon, managing director and head of applied equity advisors at Morgan Stanley, says he's happy with what Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said during his speech at Jackson Hole and he remains consistent. Slimmon says the threat of an interest rate hike is causing a change in leadership in stock markets. He shares more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
